title: Remove ineffective EF write-content configuration
goal: Remove obsolete EF Cosmos write-content configuration while preserving saved values and concurrency protection.

selectionNotes: Remove the ContentResponseOnWriteEnabled call from EF configuration. The comparison deliberately retains enabled, disabled and omitted controls; null here means omit the call, not pass null to the bool parameter. The current option is obsolete; its nullable internal setting is not a new public nullable parameter. Saved values, refreshed ETags and stale-write rejection must still work. The direct Cosmos SDK has its own response options: this recipe makes no SDK-wide network, CPU, RU or performance claim.
